items.title: George "Pops" Foster Interview, 1958-08-24
items.q: Now you take Charlie, McCutty, George and Teo and them, they played out in the middle of that horn.

ctx.x: Yeah, you ought to keep one, get it all pasted in before you lose some of those.

And here, they give me a birthday party on the Queen Mary, see? I'm sitting at the table waiting, man, wondering why they come in. And here they come in there, blast away. This is Alma's- Surprise. Yeah, this is Alma's brother, that's the one we live in, Charlie.
